level.description:
The name of the data property that defines which level a node belongs to in the radial or sequential layout. The property must contain a numeric value, where the lowest number is the top of the hierarchy.
This should be the name of the key we want to use from the fetched nodes
**Required** when the {@link name} property is either radial or sequential.

packing.description: The packing mode to arrange subgraphs. Not used by 'lens'.

stretch.description: The spacing between levels in sequential layouts. Values must be positive.

tightness.description: Controls how close nodes are spaced, with higher values making nodes closer. Ranges from 0-10.

stacking.description: The positioning of nodes that share the same neighbors and level in the sequential layout.

title: Type to define the layout options for {@link UiSdlGraphVisualization}.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationLayout
